blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government has assured the public that it has enough funds and resources to respond to the continuing effects of the conflict in the Middle East, including rising fuel prices, transport costs and the needs of affected overseas Filipinos. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto made the assurance during the UPLIFT Committee meeting in Malacañang on Thursday to assess the government’s preparations amid renewed tensions in the region. “Two straits are now blocked and fuel prices are climbing again. Although they remain below April’s peak, we should not be complacent. We should not wait for prices to reach their worst before […]...
